# Revelance

> Revelance is a private business club and event venue at 8460 Duke Blvd, Mason, Ohio 45040 (Deerfield Township, Warren County). It is a standalone 25,000+ sq ft building designed and built from the ground up by Managing Partners Patrick Malloy and Joe Clark. It is NOT a coworking space — it is a full-service business club with premium workspace, event facilities, and lifestyle amenities under one roof.

## Location

- Address: 8460 Duke Blvd, Mason, OH 45040
- Township: Deerfield Township (Mason mailing address)
- County: Warren County, Ohio
- Coordinates: 39.3135, -84.3025
- Highway access: Approximately 1 mile off Interstate 71
- Parking: Private lot exclusively for the building, free, EV chargers available
- Elevator: Yes
- Nearby: Sonder Brewing's full-service restaurant across the parking lot (8584 Duke Blvd), Kingswood Park (90+ acres of trails) directly across the street
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?q=8460+Duke+Blvd+Mason+OH+45040

## About

Revelance was designed by Patrick Malloy and Joe Clark, who assembled a group of local investors, oversaw every phase of construction, and now operate the facility as their own daily headquarters. They are on-site every day. The building is home to established businesses in finance, foodservice, and medical devices alongside coworking members.

## Key Facilities

### RoboJo Coffee Bar (Lobby — Open to Public)
- Fully automated robotic barista featuring Script Coffee, a local roaster (https://script-coffee.com/)
- 250+ drinks in under 60 seconds: hot lattes, iced coffees, cappuccinos, hot chocolate, and more
- MyAppCafé app: pre-order drinks, print custom latte art from your camera roll, save favorites, earn loyalty rewards
- App download: iPhone (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myappcaf%C3%A9/id1567580725) | Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.myappcafe.myappcafe.myAppCafe_android&hl=en-US)
- Open to the public — no membership required

### Fresh Blends Smoothie & Shake Bar (Co-Revel Café, 2nd Floor)
- Robotic blender by Fresh Blends (https://freshblends.com/)
- All natural — no artificial flavors, colors, or high fructose corn syrup
- Menu: fruit smoothies, shakes, frappes, frozen lemonades, iced cold brew, refreshers, organic options
- Full menu: https://freshblends.com/products/

### The Taproom (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/taphouse/)
- Private craft beer bar inside the building operated by Sonder Brewing bartenders
- IMPORTANT: This is Revelance's own taproom featuring Sonder beer — NOT a Sonder taproom. In site copy it is called "The Taproom"; its page URL is /taphouse/. Sonder Brewing's separate full-service restaurant is across the parking lot at 8584 Duke Blvd.
- Craft beer on tap, wine, spirits
- No event markup — drinks at standard menu prices
- Bartender included with every event

### Revel Room Event Center (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/revel-room/)
- Seats 125 banquet-style (~50'x30') with 25' ceilings
- 12'x10' video wall, private bar featuring Sonder Brewing
- 225 Max capacity across connected spaces (Revel Room + Taproom + lobby + Emergency 9 Golf Simulator and Conference Room)
- Flexible configuration for one large event or multiple simultaneous events
- No mandatory catering — bring any caterer, food truck, or self-cater

### C-Suite Bourbon Lockers (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/c-suite/)
- 50 personal keyed bourbon lockers in an exclusive executive lounge
- 24/7 access, 65" TV, surround sound, private tastings
- Included with Executive Office memberships

### Emergency 9 Golf Simulator and Conference Room (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/e9/)
- Private golf simulator suite with conference seating for 25–40 people
- ProTee VX simulator with a 10'x16' impact screen
- Available for members, corporate entertainment, team building, and events

### Culinary Lab (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/culinary-lab/)
- Commercial-grade kitchen available by the hour, day, or ongoing
- Use cases: food truck commissary, chef menu development, cooking classes, corporate tastings, private chef dinners
- Equipment: range, walk-in cooler, prep stations, three-bay sink

### Boardrooms (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/boardrooms/)
- Foundation Boardroom: seats 10 · Horizon Boardroom: seats 12 · Overlook Boardroom: seats 6
- Cornerstone Boardroom: reserved for Dedicated Desk members and above
- All with built-in AV
- Large-format displays, high-speed WiFi, whiteboards, markers
- No AV fees, no WiFi surcharges, no hidden technology charges

### Coworking (Dedicated 2nd Floor) (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/coworking/)
- Completely separated from event spaces — never interrupted by events
- Co-Revel Lounge, Co-Revel Café, dedicated desks, executive offices
- Phone booths available to all members

## Memberships & Pricing (page URL: https://revelanceoh.com/memberships/)

- **Day Pass**: $29/day — full-day coworking, WiFi, phone booths, RoboJo Coffee Bar on-site
- **Co-Revel**: $179/month — 24/7 coworking, Revelance App (phone = key), Taproom access, Fresh Blends smoothies & shakes, member events, networking
- **Dedicated Desk**: $449/month — lockable personal desk, storage, all Co-Revel perks
- **Executive Office**: Starting at $1,599/month (limited availability) — private office with signage, personal bourbon locker, 24/7 C-Suite access
- **Free Day Pass**: Complimentary full-day trial, no credit card required — https://revelanceoh.com/#free-day
- **Corporate Account**: Pre-funded flexible account — one balance covers boardrooms, events, day passes, golf simulator, culinary experiences, Taproom tabs

## Events

### Event Types Hosted
- Weddings, wedding receptions, and rehearsal dinners (page: https://revelanceoh.com/weddings/) — 125 banquet / 225 combined capacity, 25-ft ceilings
- Corporate events, offsites, and retreats (page: https://revelanceoh.com/corporate/) — boardrooms, Revel Room, golf-simulator entertainment under one roof
- Holiday parties and company celebrations (page: https://revelanceoh.com/holiday-parties/) — Q4 books fastest; bartender included, no mandatory catering. Formats: Taproom-only casual party (up to 50), Revel Room seated dinner (125), or both combined (225)
- Team building, trainings, and seminars — boardrooms seat 6–12, E9 suite seats 25–40
- Networking events, watch parties, fundraisers, and social celebrations
- Event venue overview: https://revelanceoh.com/host-an-event/

- No mandatory catering — bring your own food, hire any caterer, order from restaurants, or request turnkey coordination
- Bartender included with every event, drinks at standard Sonder prices
- No event markup, no hidden fees, everything quoted upfront
- Liquor license in the Taproom/Revel Room only
- White-glove turnkey service available
- Event planner tool: https://revelanceoh.com/plan-your-event/
- Events calendar: https://revelanceoh.com/events/

## Member Perks

- Revelance App: Phone-based door access (no key fobs), boardroom booking, account management, community chat and message boards
- Monthly complimentary member buffet lunches
- Chef-prepared take-home meals — pick up dinner on the way out
- RoboJo Coffee Bar with loyalty rewards via app
- Fresh Blends smoothie, shake, and frappé bar
- Taproom access (Sonder Brewing)
- Networking events, watch parties, comedy nights
- Professional business address at 8460 Duke Blvd
- Mail and package handling
